description: R-ENC-1 fixture: a ACCDB created with the password carried in the locale string (dbLangGeneral & ";pwd=secret1"). Content: table T(ID, S indexed, M memo of 3,000 characters, 64 rows spanning pages), table U with a text key and a foreign key to T (one non-ASCII value), and saved query Q_T. The file image before NewPassword (when used) and after close is kept.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, S TEXT(50), M MEMO)

INSERT INTO T (ID, S, M) VALUES (1, 'r1', '')
INSERT INTO T (ID, S, M) SELECT ID + 1, 'r' & (ID + 1), M FROM T
INSERT INTO T (ID, S, M) SELECT ID + 2, 'r' & (ID + 2), M FROM T
INSERT INTO T (ID, S, M) SELECT ID + 4, 'r' & (ID + 4), M FROM T
INSERT INTO T (ID, S, M) SELECT ID + 8, 'r' & (ID + 8), M FROM T
INSERT INTO T (ID, S, M) SELECT ID + 16, 'r' & (ID + 16), M FROM T

CREATE TABLE U (K TEXT(20) CONSTRAINT PK_U PRIMARY KEY, TID LONG)
